name: data-forge
summary: Intelligent data cleaning, format conversion, and quality validation tool. Use when you need to clean messy/dirty data, convert between CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown/SQL formats, infer data schemas, deduplicate, handle missing values, normalize formats, detect anomalies, map columns fuzzy-matching, or generate data quality reports. Essential for any agent working with extracted tables, scraped web data, API responses, or user-provided datasets.
